About the reconstruction

Traced from the ASEPT project plan, PRO ind. 1, 12 October 2026, and checked against its four 3D references. Printed dimensions govern the main room widths. The tapered façade and openings follow the drawing.

The red entry/bathroom zone has a white plasterboard ceiling at 2.90 m. The blue living/kitchen zone reaches 4.00 m, with a longitudinal main beam and transverse timber joists.

Beam section (30 × 40 cm), joist spacing, window heights, furniture and the other rooms’ 4 m ceilings are illustrative assumptions. This is a design model, not a measured survey. Clear height below the main beam is approximately 3.60 m.
